title: Replacement for falsely completed task 6638: design(queue): durable task data model — blocker links, park revalidation, status reasons + notes, full event history, actor provenance (#3424)
body: Replacement task enqueued by lane code-w (2026-11-09) after task 6638 was erroneously completed as already_done during a GitHub GraphQL rate-limit outage: the worker's fresh-state read returned empty and the completion was recorded without evidence. Fresh REST verification shows issue #3424 is OPEN. Work this task as the original triage task: revalidate against current GitHub state, then proceed per the runbook.
